orgs.name: Shivsena Shetkari Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Shetkari Sena is dedicated to safeguarding the rights and welfare of farmers across Maharashtra while promoting the holistic development of the agricultural sector. The organisation actively works to ensure fair prices for agricultural produce, improved irrigation facilities, effective crop insurance, and greater access to government welfare schemes. Serving as a strong voice for the farming community, it strives to bring the concerns and aspirations of rural Maharashtra to the attention of policymakers and administrators.

orgs.name: Maharashtra State Teachers and Non-Teaching Staff Sena
orgs.body: The Maharashtra State Teachers and Non-Teaching Staff Sena works to protect the rights and interests of teachers and non-teaching employees while contributing to the advancement of the education sector. The organisation advocates on matters relating to service conditions, salaries, pensions, promotions, grants, recruitment to vacant posts, and other professional concerns. It remains committed to strengthening the education system and ensuring the welfare of teaching and non-teaching personnel.

orgs.name: Sthaniya Lokadhikar Sena Mahasangh
orgs.body: Established in line with Shivsena Pramukh Hindu Hriday Samrat Balasaheb Thackeray’s vision of securing justice for the sons of the soil, the Sthaniya Lokadhikar Sena Mahasangh works to promote employment, entrepreneurship, and economic opportunities for local youth in Maharashtra. The organisation advocates for fair representation of local residents across government, semi-government, banking, industrial, and private sectors while protecting their legitimate rights and interests.

orgs.name: Shivsena Dharmaveer Spiritual Wing
orgs.body: The Shivsena Dharmaveer Spiritual Wing is devoted to preserving and promoting the traditions of the saints, the Warkari movement, Hindu culture, and spiritual values. Through religious awareness programmes, cultural initiatives, and community outreach, it seeks to strengthen devotion, moral values, national consciousness, and social harmony while fostering a deeper appreciation of Hindutva and India’s spiritual heritage.

orgs.name: Social Justice Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Social Justice Department is committed to advancing the rights and welfare of socially and economically disadvantaged communities. It works on issues affecting Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Nomadic Tribes, Denotified Tribes, Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and economically weaker sections by advocating for equitable access to government schemes, raising awareness about legal and social rights, and pursuing justice for those facing discrimination or hardship.

orgs.name: OBC Bara Balutedar Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena OBC Bara Balutedar Department works towards protecting the rights, promoting social empowerment, and encouraging the overall development of OBC communities and the traditional Bara Balutedar communities of Maharashtra. The department actively advocates on issues related to education, employment, reservations, entrepreneurship, and social justice while ensuring that government welfare initiatives reach every eligible beneficiary.

orgs.name: Uttar Bharatiya Sanghatana
orgs.body: The Shivsena Uttar Bharatiya Sanghatana seeks to engage members of the North Indian community residing in Maharashtra while addressing their social, educational, cultural, and civic concerns. By fostering unity among diverse communities, the organisation promotes national integration, social harmony, and mutual respect.

orgs.name: Rajasthani Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Rajasthani Department works to organise and support the Rajasthani community living in Maharashtra by addressing its social, cultural, educational, and business-related concerns. The department also strives to strengthen social harmony between the Rajasthani community and the people of Maharashtra while facilitating constructive engagement with government institutions and promoting public welfare initiatives.

orgs.name: Mali Samaj Kranti Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Mali Samaj Kranti Sena is dedicated to the social, educational, economic, and political empowerment of the Mali community. It encourages access to education, employment, entrepreneurship, and leadership opportunities while working collectively to address community issues, promote social awareness, strengthen unity, and facilitate access to government welfare schemes.

orgs.name: State Library Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena State Library Cell promotes reading culture, intellectual growth, and the strengthening of the library movement across Maharashtra. It supports the development of libraries in both rural and urban areas, encourages reading habits among students, facilitates access to resources for scholars and researchers, and undertakes initiatives aimed at fostering a knowledge-driven society. Through its activities, the Cell seeks to nurture informed citizenship, intellectual engagement, and lifelong learning.

orgs.name: Christian Minority Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Christian Minority Cell is dedicated to promoting the social, educational, cultural, and economic development of the Christian community. The Cell works to effectively represent community concerns before government authorities and administrative bodies, ensuring that legitimate issues receive due attention and resolution. It also guides young people in accessing educational and employment opportunities while encouraging greater participation in mainstream social and civic life. Committed to the values of national integration, social harmony, and fraternity, the Cell strives to strengthen engagement between the Christian community and Shivsena through continuous outreach and public service initiatives.

orgs.name: Sikh–Punjabi Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Sikh–Punjabi Cell works for the social, cultural, and educational advancement of the Sikh and Punjabi community. It actively represents community concerns before government and administrative authorities and consistently pursues their effective resolution. Inspired by the Sikh community’s traditions of patriotism, courage, and selfless service, the Cell seeks to connect youth with opportunities for growth, promote social harmony, and reinforce the spirit of national unity. Through initiatives focused on public welfare and national interest, it continues to make a meaningful contribution to society.

orgs.name: Nabhik Samaj Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Nabhik Samaj Sena is committed to the social, educational, economic, and professional development of the Nabhik community. It addresses issues related to traditional occupations while promoting employment, self-employment, and skill development opportunities for young members of the community. The organisation also works to strengthen community unity, facilitate access to various government welfare schemes, and support the overall progress and empowerment of the Nabhik community.

orgs.name: Ex-Servicemen Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Ex-Servicemen Cell is dedicated to safeguarding the welfare and legitimate rights of retired armed forces personnel who have devoted their lives to the service of the nation. It assists ex-servicemen, war widows, and their families in accessing government welfare schemes and supports them in matters related to rehabilitation, employment, pensions, and administrative concerns. The Cell also seeks to ensure that the experience and expertise of former servicemen continue to benefit society while upholding their dignity and honour.

orgs.name: Shivudyog Sahakar Sena
orgs.body: Shivudyog Sahakar Sena works to accelerate Maharashtra’s economic growth by promoting entrepreneurship and the cooperative sector. The organisation encourages micro, small, and medium enterprises, cooperative institutions, self-employment, and emerging entrepreneurs, thereby contributing to job creation and economic development. By providing guidance on industry-related challenges, government policies, financial assistance, and business expansion, it seeks to empower entrepreneurs and foster a self-reliant and employment-oriented Maharashtra.

orgs.name: Shivsena Construction Workers Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Construction Workers Sena is committed to protecting the rights, social security, and overall welfare of workers in the construction sector. It works to ensure that construction workers benefit from government schemes, healthcare facilities, insurance coverage, educational assistance for their children, and various welfare programmes. The organisation also represents the concerns of workers in the unorganised sector before government authorities, striving to secure justice and improve their quality of life.

orgs.name: Shivsena South India Division
orgs.body: The Shivsena South India Division works to engage South Indian communities residing in Maharashtra and address their social, cultural, and civic concerns. By bringing together people from Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana, the Division promotes social harmony, national integration, and mutual cooperation. It also strives to strengthen the contribution of South Indian communities to Maharashtra’s development while fostering meaningful engagement with Shivsena’s public service initiatives. Coordinator: Mr. Jayant K. Nair – Coordinator

orgs.name: Telugu Community Division
orgs.body: The Telugu Community Division works to organise various sections of the Telugu-speaking community and advocate for their concerns before government and administrative authorities. It promotes educational opportunities, employment, and social advancement for youth while encouraging national integration, communal harmony, and fraternity. The Division also aims to strengthen the Telugu community’s contribution to Maharashtra’s progress and extend Shivsena’s commitment to public service across the community.

officeBearers.name: Mr. Tirupati Reddy M. Keshi Reddy

orgs.name: Shivsena Kannada Community Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Kannada Community Cell serves as a cultural and social bridge between Maharashtra and Karnataka. It brings together Kannada-speaking residents of Maharashtra and provides guidance, support, and assistance in addressing their various concerns. With an emphasis on mutual respect, fraternity, and public welfare, the Cell works to connect the Kannada community with Shivsena’s broader mission of service and community engagement.

orgs.name: Shivsena Tamil Community Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Tamil Community Cell was established to engage the Tamil community, whose contributions have played an important role in Maharashtra’s development, with Shivsena’s vision of public service. The Cell addresses civic, educational, and social issues affecting Tamil-speaking residents of the state and works to strengthen communication and cooperation between the community and the organisation. By fostering unity and active participation, it seeks to organise and empower the Tamil community while advancing initiatives for public welfare.

orgs.name: Shivsena Legal Affairs Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Legal Affairs Department is dedicated to providing timely legal guidance and access to justice for citizens, Shivsainiks, and underprivileged sections of society. The Department offers legal advice and assistance on matters relating to land and property, cooperative societies, labour issues, women's rights, senior citizens' concerns, and various civil and criminal matters. Its primary objective is to stand firmly with individuals facing injustice, advocate for their legitimate rights, and raise public awareness about legal provisions and government regulations. Guided by the belief that justice should be accessible to every citizen, the Department continues to provide legal support and public service across a wide range of issues.

orgs.name: Shivsena Adivasi Samaj
orgs.body: The Shivsena Adivasi Samaj is committed to protecting the rights of tribal communities across Maharashtra, advocating for their concerns, and ensuring that government welfare schemes reach remote and tribal regions. The organisation actively pursues issues related to education, healthcare, employment, forest rights, land rights, and access to essential services. While preserving the traditions, culture, and identity of tribal communities, it works to integrate them into the mainstream of development. Its central mission is to effectively represent the voices of tribal citizens before the government and work towards their holistic empowerment and progress.

orgs.name: Minority Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Minority Sena works to engage minority communities in Shivsena's vision of public service while addressing their social, educational, and economic concerns. The organisation provides guidance and support in areas such as education, employment, self-employment, access to government welfare schemes, and various civic matters. It is committed to promoting national integration, fraternity, and mutual understanding while dispelling misconceptions and encouraging constructive dialogue. The Minority Sena also represents the concerns of minority communities before government and administrative authorities, advocating for their legitimate rights and welfare.

orgs.name: Shivsena Consumer Protection Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Consumer Protection Cell is dedicated to safeguarding consumer rights and addressing issues such as unfair trade practices, deficient services, fraudulent transactions, and other forms of consumer injustice. It works to educate consumers about their rights, provide guidance on grievances, and, where necessary, assist them in presenting their cases before the appropriate authorities and consumer forums. The Cell's primary objective is to ensure that consumers receive fair treatment and timely justice while strengthening awareness and protection of consumer rights.

orgs.name: Slum Federation – Maharashtra State
orgs.body: The Slum Federation, Maharashtra State, works to strengthen the struggle for housing rights, dignity, and social justice for residents of slum communities. The organisation actively follows up with government authorities on matters relating to slum rehabilitation, housing rights, water supply, electricity, roads, sanitation, and other essential civic amenities. It advocates for fair treatment of residents during rehabilitation projects, protects their rights, and strives to ensure that every family has access to safe and secure housing. Representing the concerns of slum dwellers before government authorities and securing justice for them remains its foremost objective.

orgs.name: VJNT (B) Division
orgs.body: The Shivsena VJNT (B) Division is committed to protecting the rights of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes while promoting social justice and inclusive empowerment. It actively pursues issues related to education, reservations, employment, housing, caste certificates, and access to various government welfare schemes. The Division works to amplify the voices of historically marginalised communities before government authorities and advocates for their legitimate demands. It is dedicated to fostering self-respect, organisational strength, and sustainable development within these communities.

orgs.name: Vanjari Samaj Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Vanjari Samaj Sena is dedicated to protecting the rights of the Vanjari community and promoting its social empowerment and overall development. The organisation encourages greater access to education, employment, entrepreneurship, and opportunities in public life, particularly for the younger generation. By organising the community and effectively representing its concerns before government and administrative authorities, it seeks to foster unity, leadership, and self-confidence while enabling greater participation in the mainstream development process.

orgs.name: Shivsena Doctors Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Doctors Cell is committed to ensuring that quality healthcare reaches every section of society and that patients in need receive timely medical assistance. The Cell brings together doctors, medical specialists, and healthcare professionals from across the state while representing their professional, administrative, and service-related concerns. It serves as a bridge between the medical community and society by advocating for healthcare issues, conveying the legitimate concerns of medical professionals to the government, and promoting public health initiatives. Through free medical camps, health awareness programmes, medical guidance, and assistance to needy patients, the Cell continues to serve society with the guiding principle that service to patients is service to humanity.

orgs.name: Shivsena Housing Complex Grievance Redressal Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Housing Complex Grievance Redressal Cell addresses issues relating to housing societies, cooperative housing societies, and residential complexes in Mumbai and Thane. It provides guidance and assistance on matters including redevelopment projects, society administration, property transfers, maintenance charges, landlord-tenant disputes, and various legal and administrative concerns. The Cell works to safeguard the rights of residents, ensure fairness during redevelopment processes, and facilitate timely resolution of housing-related grievances. By coordinating effectively with citizens and government authorities, it plays an important role in resolving residential issues and protecting the interests of homeowners and residents.

orgs.name: Shivsena Mehatar, Rukhi and Valmiki (Independent) Division – Maharashtra State
orgs.body: The Shivsena Mehatar, Rukhi and Valmiki (Independent) Division, Maharashtra State, is dedicated to protecting the rights, dignity, and social justice of the Mehatar, Rukhi, and Valmiki communities. The Division works to ensure access to education, employment, housing, reservations, social security, and government welfare schemes for all sections of these communities. Its key objectives include representing community concerns before government and administrative authorities, advocating for their legitimate rights, and guiding young people towards greater participation in mainstream social and economic development. Guided by the principles of equality, self-respect, and empowerment, the Division remains committed to the comprehensive advancement of the communities it serves.

orgs.name: Shivsena Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Nomadic and Denotified Tribes Department is dedicated to securing justice, dignity, and equal opportunities for Nomadic and Denotified Tribes that have historically faced social exclusion and systemic challenges. The Department works to organise and represent these communities, ensuring that their identity, rights, and concerns are effectively voiced before the government and relevant authorities. In addition to promoting access to education, employment, housing, and social security, the Department is committed to empowering the younger generation with confidence and self-respect. By combining a legacy of resilience with a vision for inclusive development, it strives to ensure that Nomadic and Denotified Tribes receive their rightful place in mainstream society.

orgs.name: Shivsena Shiv Lahusena Organisation
orgs.body: The Shivsena Shiv Lahusena Organisation works to uphold the legacy of revolutionary social reformer Krantiveer Lahuji Vastad Salve and his ideals of courage, self-respect, and social justice. The organisation seeks to unite young people from underprivileged, marginalised, and working-class communities while nurturing leadership, social responsibility, and a spirit of public service. It regularly undertakes initiatives to raise awareness about social issues, connect youth with opportunities for development, and encourage active participation in community welfare. Inspired by the vision of Lahuji Vastad Salve, the organisation is committed to building a generation of confident, socially conscious, and community-oriented youth.

orgs.name: Shivsena Non-Teaching Staff Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Non-Teaching Staff Sena represents the rights and legitimate interests of non-teaching employees serving in schools, colleges, and other educational institutions. The organisation advocates on issues related to salaries, service conditions, promotions, pensions, recruitment to vacant posts, and various administrative matters. Recognising the vital role of non-teaching staff in the education system, it continuously works to secure fairness, dignity, and professional security for its members while strengthening their collective representation.

orgs.name: Shivsena Film Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Film Sena serves as a platform for addressing the concerns of artists, technicians, producers, directors, and behind-the-scenes professionals associated with the Marathi film industry, theatre, television, and the broader entertainment sector. Committed to promoting the Marathi language, culture, and creative arts, the organisation works to create a supportive environment for the growth of the Marathi entertainment industry while safeguarding the interests of artists and cultural professionals.

orgs.name: Shivsena Traders Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Traders Sena works to represent and safeguard the interests of small, medium, and large traders across Maharashtra. It actively advocates on issues relating to taxation, licensing, local administration, changing market conditions, and policies that affect ease of doing business. By providing an organised platform for the trading community and pursuing its concerns before the government, the organisation seeks to protect commercial interests while promoting confidence, security, and sustainable growth among traders.

orgs.name: Shivsena Navkranti Kamgar Navik Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Navkranti Kamgar Navik Sena is dedicated to protecting the legitimate rights and welfare of workers, seafarers, and employees associated with the maritime sector in Maharashtra. The organisation advocates for employment security, fair wages, safe working conditions, social security benefits, and other labour-related issues affecting these sectors. By effectively representing the concerns of industrial, port, and maritime workers before government authorities and relevant agencies, it strives to ensure justice and uphold the dignity, safety, and rights of the workforce.

orgs.name: Shivsena Scheduled Castes Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Scheduled Castes Department works to organise and represent the Scheduled Castes community while advocating for justice and equal opportunities. It actively follows up on matters related to education, employment, reservations, social security schemes, and the effective implementation of government welfare programmes. The Department also conducts initiatives to promote educational advancement, employment opportunities, and awareness of constitutional and legal rights among youth. Guided by the principles of equality and social justice championed by Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar, it remains committed to the progress and empowerment of Scheduled Castes.

orgs.name: Shivsena State Industry Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena State Industry Sena is committed to promoting industrial growth, entrepreneurship, and employment generation across Maharashtra. The organisation provides guidance and encouragement to aspiring entrepreneurs, small and medium enterprises, and startup ventures while facilitating awareness of relevant government schemes and support mechanisms. It also raises issues concerning industrial policies, regulatory approvals, investments, and sector-specific challenges before the government to foster a business-friendly environment. Its overarching objective is to build a self-reliant generation of entrepreneurs and contribute to a prosperous, employment-driven Maharashtra.

orgs.name: Shivsena Gujarati Division
orgs.body: The Shivsena Gujarati Division seeks to engage the Gujarati community, many of whom have made Maharashtra their home and workplace, in Shivsena's vision of public service. The Division promotes mutual trust, fraternity, and cultural harmony between the Marathi and Gujarati communities while providing guidance and support on issues affecting Gujarati residents. By encouraging coordination and cooperation among diverse social groups, it contributes to social unity and supports the inclusive development of Maharashtra.

orgs.name: Shivsena Media and Publicity Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Media and Publicity Department is responsible for communicating the party's positions, ideology, public service initiatives, and organisational activities to the wider public. The Department disseminates official information through newspapers, television channels, digital platforms, and social media while coordinating with media organisations and conveying the party's views on important developments. Its primary objective is to strengthen public communication through accurate and effective dissemination of information and to ensure broad awareness of Shivsena's activities and initiatives.

orgs.name: Shivsena Malayalam Community Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Malayalam Community Sena works to represent the concerns of the Malayali community in Maharashtra by bringing their issues before government and administrative authorities and facilitating the support they require. It seeks to connect Malayalam-speaking residents with Shivsena’s vision of public service while fostering dialogue, coordination, and social unity within the community. The organisation also promotes mutual respect, cultural exchange, and fraternity between the Malayali community and other sections of society in Maharashtra. Its activities are guided by the principles of public welfare, community service, and social harmony.

orgs.name: Shivsena Sindhi Community Organisation
orgs.body: The Shivsena Sindhi Community Organisation is committed to preserving the rich heritage, cultural traditions, and spirit of public service of the Sindhi community while promoting harmony and cooperation among the diverse communities of Maharashtra. Through initiatives based on social welfare, national commitment, and community service, the organisation seeks to strengthen mutual understanding and foster inclusive development.

orgs.name: Shivsena Nepali Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Nepali Sena provides an organised platform for the Nepali community residing in Maharashtra. It represents the concerns of Nepali citizens—many of whom contribute in the fields of security, public service, labour, and various professions before government and administrative authorities while facilitating appropriate support and assistance. The organisation also works to strengthen dialogue, mutual respect, and social harmony between the Nepali community and other communities in Maharashtra. Its activities are guided by the values of patriotism, discipline, and public service.

orgs.name: Dharmaveer Anand Dighe Government Employees Service Association
orgs.body: The Dharmaveer Anand Dighe Government Employees Service Association is dedicated to representing the service-related concerns of government employees through an organised platform. The Association advocates on matters such as promotions, pay scales, pensions, service conditions, and various administrative issues by engaging with the appropriate government authorities. It works continuously to safeguard the legitimate rights of government employees and ensure the timely resolution of their concerns. Inspired by the public service ideals of Dharmaveer Anand Dighe, the Association also promotes constructive coordination between government employees and the administration.

orgs.name: Shivsena Agri-Koli Community
orgs.body: The Shivsena Agri-Koli Community organisation is committed to protecting the rights, identity, and traditional way of life of the Agri-Koli community, one of Maharashtra’s indigenous communities. It actively pursues issues affecting coastal fishing communities, including traditional fishing rights, saline lands, land acquisition matters, and livelihood-related concerns before the government. The organisation also works to preserve the cultural heritage and social identity of the Agri-Koli community while connecting younger generations with opportunities for development and progress. Advocacy for the community’s legitimate rights and welfare remains at the core of its mission.

orgs.name: Sant Nirankari Mandal
orgs.body: The Sant Nirankari Mandal works to strengthen the organisational outreach of the Sant Nirankari Mission’s spiritual, social, and humanitarian initiatives. Guided by the values of humanity, fraternity, selfless service, and social unity, the Mandal undertakes a range of activities aimed at creating a positive impact in society. Its initiatives include blood donation drives, tree plantation campaigns, cleanliness programmes, health awareness activities, and other community service projects. By integrating spirituality with social responsibility, the Mandal seeks to promote harmony, compassion, and collective well-being.

orgs.name: Shivsena Defence Training Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Defence Training Department is dedicated to instilling discipline, patriotism, and awareness of defence services among young people. It provides guidance, training, and encouragement to those aspiring to build careers in the Indian Armed Forces, paramilitary organisations, police services, and other security agencies. Through a variety of training programmes, the organisation seeks to develop physical fitness, leadership qualities, and a strong sense of national responsibility. With a firm belief that service to the nation is the highest form of service, it is committed to nurturing disciplined, capable, and patriotic youth.

orgs.name: Shivsena Police Family Welfare Department
orgs.body: The Shivsena Police Family Welfare Department is dedicated to the welfare of police officers, personnel, and their families who work tirelessly to maintain law and order across the state. The organisation provides guidance and assistance on various social and welfare-related issues affecting police families during active service as well as after retirement. It also supports students from police families, creates awareness about government welfare schemes, and assists in raising and resolving their concerns with the relevant authorities. Standing firmly alongside the families of those who serve and protect society remains the organisation’s foremost commitment.

orgs.name: Shivsena Soldiers Front Organisation
orgs.body: The Shivsena Soldiers Front Organisation provides a dedicated platform for ex-servicemen, retired defence officers, and veterans who have devoted their lives to the service of the nation. The organisation works to address issues related to pensions, rehabilitation, welfare, and post-retirement administrative matters by representing them before the appropriate government authorities. Its principal objectives are to uphold the dignity of military personnel, safeguard the welfare of their families, and strengthen the spirit of national service within society. Inspired by the principle of “Nation First,” the organisation remains committed to honouring the proud legacy of India’s armed forces.

orgs.name: Shivkalin Mardani Sports Training Sena
orgs.body: The Shivkalin Mardani Sports Training Sena is dedicated to preserving the martial traditions, bravery, and combat skills associated with the era of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The organisation provides training in traditional martial disciplines such as swordsmanship, dandpatta, stick fighting, spear techniques, and other indigenous combat arts, helping young people develop physical fitness, self-confidence, and discipline. It also organises training camps and demonstrations to introduce new generations to Maharashtra’s rich historical heritage while promoting self-defence and a sense of national pride. By preserving these traditional martial arts, the organisation seeks to nurture strong, disciplined, and culturally rooted youth.

orgs.name: Shivpratap Sena
orgs.body: The Shivpratap Sena is dedicated to promoting the ideals of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, preserving the history of Swarajya, and celebrating Maharashtra’s rich cultural and historical heritage. The organisation conducts a range of initiatives focused on the study of Shivaji Maharaj’s life and legacy, conservation of forts and historical monuments, and preservation of the state’s historical traditions. Inspired by the values and vision of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the Shivpratap Sena also works to foster public service, organisational strength, and a spirit of national commitment among citizens, particularly the youth. Its primary objective is to build a strong, self-reliant, and patriotic society by drawing inspiration from history and promoting pride in Maharashtra’s legacy.

orgs.name: Women Empowerment Department
orgs.body: The Women Empowerment Department is committed to promoting the social, educational, economic, and legal empowerment of women. It provides guidance and assistance on issues related to injustice, violence against women, family matters, and access to various government welfare schemes. The Department also organises awareness campaigns and developmental initiatives aimed at encouraging women’s self-reliance, leadership, and active participation in society. Its overarching mission is to foster a safe, dignified, and empowering environment in which women can realise their full potential.

orgs.name: Shivsena Self-Employment Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Self-Employment Cell works to promote self-reliance and entrepreneurship by helping young men and women overcome unemployment through sustainable livelihood opportunities. The organisation provides guidance, training, and information on government schemes, financial assistance, and business development for individuals seeking to establish enterprises in industry, commerce, services, or small-scale businesses. By encouraging entrepreneurship and job creation, the Cell aims to develop self-sufficient individuals who contribute to economic growth and community development. Its vision is to build an empowered youth and a self-reliant Maharashtra.

orgs.name: Shivsena Shivudyog Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Shivudyog Sena is dedicated to strengthening Maharashtra’s industrial sector and creating new employment opportunities for local youth. The organisation brings together entrepreneurs, business leaders, and emerging enterprises to foster an environment conducive to industrial growth and economic development. It actively represents industry-related concerns, policy matters, and challenges before government authorities while advocating for greater employment opportunities for local residents. Through its initiatives, the organisation seeks to promote industrial expansion, generate jobs, and contribute to a prosperous and economically resilient Maharashtra.

orgs.name: Dharmaveer Anand Dighe Citizen Assistance Cell
orgs.body: Inspired by the public service ideals of Dharmaveer Anand Dighe, the Dharmaveer Anand Dighe Citizen Assistance Cell has been established to provide support and guidance to the general public in addressing everyday civic concerns. The Cell assists citizens in resolving issues related to government offices, administrative procedures, and access to various government welfare schemes. By offering timely guidance, facilitating necessary follow-up with relevant authorities, and extending prompt assistance, the Cell strives to ensure the effective resolution of public grievances. It also reinforces Shivsena’s long-standing commitment to standing with citizens in times of need and delivering responsive public service.

mr.title: शिवसेना सलंग्न सेना
mr.lede: शिवसेनेच्या विचाराशी सलंग्न असलेल्या आणि विविध क्षेत्रांत समाजासाठी कार्यरत असणाऱ्या सेना — प्रत्येक घटकाचा आवाज पक्षाच्या परिवारापर्यंत पोहोचतो.

orgs.name: शिवसेना राष्ट्रीय कर्मचारी सेना
orgs.body: देशभरातील विविध शासकीय, निमशासकीय, सार्वजनिक आणि खासगी क्षेत्रात कार्यरत असलेल्या कर्मचारी वर्गाच्या न्याय्य हक्कांसाठी शिवसेना राष्ट्रीय कर्मचारी सेना कार्यरत आहे. कर्मचारी वर्गाच्या सेवाविषयक प्रश्न, वेतन, पदोन्नती, निवृत्तीवेतन, कामाच्या अटी तसेच विविध प्रशासकीय अडचणींवर संघटितपणे आवाज उठवून संबंधित यंत्रणांकडे प्रभावी पाठपुरावा करण्याचे कार्य ही सेना करते. कर्मचारी वर्गाचे हितसंबंध जपत त्यांना न्याय, सन्मान आणि सुरक्षित कार्यपरिसर मिळावा यासाठी संघटना सातत्याने प्रयत्नशील असते. संघटनशक्ती आणि जनसेवेच्या माध्यमातून कर्मचारी वर्गाचा सक्षम आवाज होणे हेच या सेनेचे प्रमुख उद्दिष्ट आहे.

orgs.name: शिवसेना सहकार सेना
orgs.body: महाराष्ट्राच्या सहकार चळवळीला नवी दिशा देत सहकारी संस्थांचे हित जपण्यासाठी शिवसेना सहकार सेना कार्यरत आहे. सहकारी साखर कारखाने, दूध संघ, पतसंस्था, कृषी संस्था, गृहनिर्माण संस्था तसेच विविध सहकारी संघटनांसमोरील प्रश्नांवर प्रभावीपणे पाठपुरावा करण्याचे कार्य ही सेना करते. सहकार क्षेत्र अधिक पारदर्शक, सक्षम आणि लोकाभिमुख व्हावे तसेच शेतकरी, सभासद आणि सामान्य घटकांच्या हितांचे संरक्षण व्हावे यासाठी संघटना सातत्याने प्रयत्नशील असते. महाराष्ट्राच्या सहकार परंपरेला बळकटी देत विकास आणि जनहित यांचा समतोल साधणे हेच या सेनेचे प्रमुख उद्दिष्ट आहे.

orgs.name: शिव कामगार सेना
orgs.body: संघटित आणि असंघटित क्षेत्रातील कामगारांच्या न्याय्य हक्कांसाठी कार्य करणारी शिव कामगार सेना ही एक प्रभावी कामगार संघटना आहे. उद्योग, कारखाने, सेवा क्षेत्र तसेच विविध आस्थापनांमध्ये कार्यरत कामगारांचे वेतन, सेवा अटी, कामगार सुरक्षा, सामाजिक संरक्षण आणि रोजगाराशी संबंधित प्रश्नांवर संघटितपणे आवाज उठवण्याचे कार्य ही संघटना करते. कामगारांना न्याय, सन्मान आणि सुरक्षित वातावरण मिळावे यासाठी संबंधित यंत्रणांकडे सातत्याने पाठपुरावा केला जातो. कामगारांचे हित जपत औद्योगिक क्षेत्रात समन्वय आणि स्थैर्य निर्माण करण्यासाठी शिव कामगार सेना कार्यरत आहे.

orgs.name: शिवसेनाप्रणित शिवसामर्थ्य संघटना
orgs.body: समाजातील वंचित, दुर्बल आणि गरजू घटकांना संघटित करून त्यांना सामाजिक, शैक्षणिक आणि आर्थिकदृष्ट्या सक्षम करण्याच्या उद्देशाने शिवसेनाप्रणित शिवसामर्थ्य संघटना कार्यरत आहे. समाजातील विविध प्रश्नांना वाचा फोडणे, शासकीय योजनांची माहिती व लाभ संबंधित घटकांपर्यंत पोहोचवणे तसेच सामाजिक न्याय आणि सक्षमीकरणासाठी जनजागृती करणे हे या संघटनेचे प्रमुख कार्य आहे. संघटनशक्ती, स्वाभिमान आणि आत्मविश्वासाच्या बळावर समाजातील प्रत्येक घटक सक्षम व्हावा, या उद्देशाने शिवसामर्थ्य संघटना सातत्याने कार्यरत आहे.

orgs.name: शिवसेनाप्रणित भारतीय कामगार संघटना
orgs.body: विविध उद्योग, आस्थापना आणि सेवा क्षेत्रांमध्ये कार्यरत कामगारांच्या न्याय्य हक्कांच्या संरक्षणासाठी शिवसेनाप्रणित भारतीय कामगार संघटना कार्यरत आहे. वेतन, सेवा अटी, रोजगार सुरक्षा, कामगार कल्याण योजना तसेच कामाच्या ठिकाणी उद्भवणाऱ्या विविध प्रश्नांवर संघटितपणे पाठपुरावा करण्याचे कार्य ही संघटना करते. कामगारांना न्याय मिळवून देतानाच औद्योगिक शांतता आणि उत्पादनक्षम वातावरण टिकवून ठेवण्यासाठी कामगार व व्यवस्थापन यांच्यात समन्वय साधण्याची भूमिकाही संघटना बजावते. कष्टकरी वर्गाचा सन्मान, सुरक्षितता आणि सामाजिक संरक्षण यासाठी भारतीय कामगार संघटना सातत्याने कार्यरत आहे.

orgs.name: शिवसेना जय महाराष्ट्र माथाडी आणि जनरल कामगार सेना
orgs.body: माथाडी कामगार, हमाल, वाहतूक, गोदाम तसेच विविध असंघटित क्षेत्रातील कष्टकरी कामगारांच्या हक्कांच्या संरक्षणासाठी शिवसेना जय महाराष्ट्र माथाडी आणि जनरल कामगार सेना कार्यरत आहे. रोजगार सुरक्षा, वेतन, कामगार कल्याण योजना, सामाजिक संरक्षण आणि कामगारांना कायदेशीर हक्क मिळवून देण्यासाठी ही संघटना सातत्याने पाठपुरावा करते. असंघटित क्षेत्रातील कामगारांना संघटित व्यासपीठ उपलब्ध करून देत त्यांच्या प्रश्नांना शासन आणि प्रशासनापर्यंत प्रभावीपणे पोहोचवण्याचे कार्य सेना करते. कष्टकरी कामगारांचा सन्मान, सुरक्षितता आणि आर्थिक स्थैर्य यासाठी ही संघटना कटिबद्ध आहे.

orgs.name: शिव फेरीवाला सेना
orgs.body: फेरीवाले, हातगाडीधारक, लघु विक्रेते आणि रस्त्यावरील व्यवसायावर उदरनिर्वाह करणाऱ्या घटकांच्या हक्कांच्या संरक्षणासाठी शिव फेरीवाला सेना कार्यरत आहे. फेरीवाला धोरण, परवाने, व्यवसायासाठी जागा, स्थानिक प्रशासनाशी संबंधित प्रश्न तसेच उपजीविकेच्या अधिकाराशी निगडित विविध विषयांवर ही संघटना सातत्याने पाठपुरावा करते. शहरांच्या अर्थव्यवस्थेत महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावणाऱ्या फेरीवाल्यांना सन्मानाने व्यवसाय करता यावा आणि त्यांच्यावर अन्याय होऊ नये यासाठी संघटना संघर्ष करत असते. फेरीवाल्यांचे हक्क, सुरक्षितता आणि आर्थिक स्थैर्य यासाठी शिव फेरीवाला सेना कटिबद्ध आहे.

orgs.name: शिवसेना महाराष्ट्र मुस्लिम मेहेत्तर सफाई कामगार संघटना सेल
orgs.body: सफाई कामगार म्हणून कार्यरत असलेल्या मुस्लिम मेहेत्तर समाजाच्या हक्कांचे संरक्षण आणि त्यांच्या जीवनमानाच्या उन्नतीसाठी शिवसेना महाराष्ट्र मुस्लिम मेहेत्तर सफाई कामगार संघटना सेल कार्यरत आहे. स्वच्छता क्षेत्रात कार्य करणाऱ्या कामगारांचे वेतन, सेवा सुरक्षा, आरोग्य सुविधा, सामाजिक संरक्षण तसेच शासकीय कल्याणकारी योजनांचा लाभ मिळवून देण्यासाठी ही संघटना सातत्याने पाठपुरावा करते. अनेक वर्षांपासून दुर्लक्षित राहिलेल्या सफाई कामगारांच्या प्रश्नांना संघटितपणे वाचा फोडून त्यांना न्याय आणि सन्मान मिळवून देणे हे या संघटनेचे प्रमुख उद्दिष्ट आहे. कष्टकरी सफाई कामगारांच्या हक्कांसाठी आणि सामाजिक सक्षमीकरणासाठी ही संघटना कटिबद्ध आहे.

orgs.name: शिव वाहतूक सेना
orgs.body: महाराष्ट्रातील मालवाहतूक, प्रवासी वाहतूक तसेच वाहतूक व्यवसायाशी संबंधित घटकांच्या प्रश्नांना संघटितपणे वाचा फोडण्यासाठी शिव वाहतूक सेना कार्यरत आहे. ट्रक, टेम्पो, टॅक्सी, रिक्षा, बस आणि इतर वाहतूक क्षेत्रातील चालक, मालक व कामगारांना भेडसावणाऱ्या विविध प्रशासकीय, परवाना, कर आणि व्यवसायविषयक अडचणींवर ही संघटना सातत्याने पाठपुरावा करते. वाहतूक क्षेत्र राज्याच्या अर्थव्यवस्थेचा महत्त्वाचा कणा असल्याची जाणीव ठेवून या क्षेत्रातील घटकांचे हितसंबंध जपणे, त्यांना न्याय मिळवून देणे आणि सुरक्षित व सुसंघटित वाहतूक व्यवस्था निर्माण करण्यासाठी शिव वाहतूक सेना कार्यरत आहे.

orgs.name: स्वाभिमानी चर्मोद्योग कामगार संस्था
orgs.body: चर्मोद्योग क्षेत्रात कार्यरत कामगार, कारागीर आणि पारंपरिक व्यवसायाशी निगडित घटकांच्या हक्कांच्या संरक्षणासाठी स्वाभिमानी चर्मोद्योग कामगार संस्था कार्यरत आहे. चर्मोद्योगाशी संबंधित कामगारांचे रोजगार, कामाच्या अटी, सामाजिक सुरक्षा, कौशल्य विकास तसेच उद्योग क्षेत्रासमोरील विविध प्रश्नांवर संघटितपणे आवाज उठवण्याचे कार्य ही संस्था करते. पारंपरिक कौशल्य जपत आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञान आणि नव्या संधींशी कामगारांना जोडण्याचा प्रयत्नही संस्था सातत्याने करत असते. चर्मोद्योग क्षेत्रातील कष्टकरी घटकांना सन्मान, न्याय आणि प्रगतीची संधी मिळवून देणे हेच संस्थेचे प्रमुख उद्दिष्ट आहे.

orgs.name: हिंदुस्थान चित्रपट कामगार संघटना
orgs.body: चित्रपटसृष्टीच्या झगमगाटामागे अहोरात्र परिश्रम घेणाऱ्या तंत्रज्ञ, सहाय्यक कर्मचारी आणि विविध कामगारांचे प्रतिनिधित्व करणारी हिंदुस्थान चित्रपट कामगार संघटना कार्यरत आहे. चित्रपटनिर्मिती प्रक्रियेत सहभागी असलेल्या कामगारांच्या रोजगार, मानधन, कामाच्या अटी आणि व्यावसायिक सुरक्षिततेशी संबंधित प्रश्नांसाठी संघटना काम करते. बदलत्या मनोरंजन उद्योगात कामगारांचे हित जपत त्यांना सन्मानाचे स्थान मिळावे, कौशल्याला योग्य संधी मिळावी आणि त्यांच्या प्रश्नांना प्रभावी व्यासपीठ उपलब्ध व्हावे यासाठी संघटना प्रयत्नशील आहे. चित्रपट क्षेत्रातील कष्टकरी वर्गाचा विश्वासार्ह आवाज म्हणून ही संघटना ओळखली जाते.

orgs.name: शिव भीम सेना फाऊंडेशन
orgs.body: छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज आणि भारतरत्न डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर यांच्या कार्यातून प्रेरणा घेऊन सामाजिक जागृती, शिक्षण आणि समाज संघटनासाठी शिव भीम सेना फाऊंडेशन कार्यरत आहे. समाजातील वंचित, उपेक्षित आणि दुर्बल घटकांना विकासाच्या मुख्य प्रवाहाशी जोडणे, युवकांमध्ये स्वाभिमान आणि सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्वाची भावना निर्माण करणे तसेच सामाजिक सलोखा आणि संविधानिक मूल्यांविषयी जनजागृती करणे हे फाऊंडेशनचे प्रमुख कार्य आहे. विविध सामाजिक, शैक्षणिक आणि जनहिताच्या उपक्रमांद्वारे समाजातील विविध घटकांमध्ये संवाद आणि सहभाग वाढविण्याचा प्रयत्न फाऊंडेशन करते. समाजहित, स्वाभिमान आणि प्रगती या मूल्यांवर आधारित कार्य हीच या फाऊंडेशनची ओळख आहे.

orgs.name: रिपब्लिकन चर्मकार महासंघ, महाराष्ट्र राज्य
orgs.body: चर्मकार समाजाच्या सामाजिक, शैक्षणिक आणि आर्थिक प्रगतीसाठी कार्यरत असलेला रिपब्लिकन चर्मकार महासंघ, महाराष्ट्र राज्य हा समाजाच्या विविध प्रश्नांसाठी संघटित व्यासपीठ म्हणून कार्य करतो. पारंपरिक व्यवसायाशी संबंधित आव्हाने, शिक्षणातील संधी, रोजगार, कौशल्य विकास तसेच शासनाच्या विविध योजनांचा लाभ समाजापर्यंत पोहोचवण्यासाठी महासंघ प्रयत्नशील असतो. समाजातील युवकांना प्रगतीच्या नव्या संधी उपलब्ध करून देणे, समाजसंघटन बळकट करणे आणि सामाजिक सहभाग वाढविणे यासाठी विविध उपक्रम राबविण्यात येतात. चर्मकार समाजाचा आत्मविश्वास, सन्मान आणि विकास यांना केंद्रस्थानी ठेवून महासंघ कार्यरत आहे.

orgs.name: भारतीय लोकशक्ती पक्ष
orgs.body: लोकहिताचे प्रश्न प्रभावीपणे मांडून सर्वसामान्य नागरिकांना न्याय मिळवून देण्यासाठी भारतीय लोकशक्ती पक्ष कार्यरत आहे. समाजातील विविध घटकांच्या अपेक्षा, स्थानिक प्रश्न आणि विकासाशी संबंधित मुद्दे लोकशाही मार्गाने शासन व प्रशासनापर्यंत पोहोचवण्याचे कार्य पक्ष करतो. सामाजिक सहभाग, जनजागृती आणि संघटनशक्तीच्या माध्यमातून नागरिकांना सार्वजनिक जीवनात अधिक सक्रिय करण्यासाठी विविध उपक्रम राबविण्यात येतात. जनतेच्या प्रश्नांना प्राधान्य देत लोकशाही मूल्ये आणि जनहित जपणे हीच भारतीय लोकशक्ती पक्षाची प्रमुख भूमिका आहे.

orgs.name: अखिल भारतीय केबल सेना
orgs.body: केबल टीव्ही, ब्रॉडबँड आणि प्रसारण सेवा क्षेत्राशी संबंधित उद्योजक, वितरक आणि कामगारांना संघटित व्यासपीठ उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी अखिल भारतीय केबल सेना कार्यरत आहे. बदलत्या तंत्रज्ञानाच्या युगात केबल उद्योगासमोरील विविध व्यावसायिक, तांत्रिक आणि प्रशासकीय प्रश्नांवर मार्गदर्शन तसेच प्रभावी पाठपुरावा करण्याचे कार्य ही संघटना करते. ग्राहकांना दर्जेदार सेवा मिळावी, स्थानिक केबल व्यावसायिकांचे हित जपले जावे आणि या क्षेत्रातील रोजगाराच्या संधी टिकून राहाव्यात यासाठी केबल सेना सातत्याने प्रयत्नशील असते. प्रसारण आणि संचार क्षेत्रातील घटकांचा सशक्त आवाज म्हणून ही संघटना कार्यरत आहे.

orgs.name: महिला कामगार संघटना, महाराष्ट्र राज्य
orgs.body: विविध क्षेत्रांमध्ये कार्यरत महिला कामगारांच्या प्रश्नांना संघटितपणे वाचा फोडण्यासाठी महिला कामगार संघटना, महाराष्ट्र राज्य कार्यरत आहे. वेतन, कामाच्या ठिकाणी सुरक्षितता, मातृत्व हक्क, सामाजिक सुरक्षा, आरोग्य सुविधा तसेच महिला कामगारांच्या कल्याणाशी संबंधित विविध विषयांवर ही संघटना कार्य करते. संघटित आणि असंघटित क्षेत्रातील महिलांना न्याय्य संधी, सन्मान आणि सुरक्षित कार्यपरिसर मिळावा यासाठी संबंधित यंत्रणांकडे सातत्याने पाठपुरावा केला जातो.

orgs.name: राष्ट्रीय कामगार युनियन
orgs.body: विविध उद्योग, सेवा क्षेत्र आणि असंघटित क्षेत्रात कार्यरत कामगारांना संघटित व्यासपीठ उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी राष्ट्रीय कामगार युनियन कार्यरत आहे. बदलत्या औद्योगिक आणि आर्थिक परिस्थितीत कामगारांच्या रोजगार सुरक्षा, वेतन, सेवा अटी, सामाजिक संरक्षण आणि कल्याणाशी संबंधित प्रश्नांवर ही युनियन प्रभावीपणे कार्य करते. कामगार आणि व्यवस्थापन यांच्यात सकारात्मक संवाद निर्माण करून औद्योगिक शांतता आणि कामगारांचे हित यांचा समतोल राखण्याचा प्रयत्न युनियनकडून केला जातो. कष्टकरी वर्गाच्या सन्मान, सुरक्षितता आणि प्रगतीसाठी राष्ट्रीय कामगार युनियन कटिबद्ध आहे.

orgs.name: महाराष्ट्र बांधकाम उद्योग सेना
orgs.body: महाराष्ट्रातील बांधकाम आणि पायाभूत सुविधा क्षेत्राशी संबंधित उद्योजक, कंत्राटदार, अभियंते तसेच उद्योग घटकांचे प्रश्न मांडण्यासाठी महाराष्ट्र बांधकाम उद्योग सेना कार्यरत आहे. बांधकाम क्षेत्रातील धोरणात्मक निर्णय, प्रशासकीय परवानग्या, नियामक अडचणी, कामगार व्यवस्थापन आणि उद्योगवाढीशी संबंधित विविध विषयांवर ही संघटना काम करते. राज्याच्या विकासात महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावणाऱ्या बांधकाम उद्योगाला सक्षम वातावरण मिळावे, प्रकल्पांना गती मिळावी आणि उद्योग क्षेत्राच्या समस्या शासनापर्यंत प्रभावीपणे पोहोचाव्यात यासाठी संघटना प्रयत्नशील असते. आधुनिक आणि विकासाभिमुख महाराष्ट्राच्या उभारणीत बांधकाम उद्योगाचे योगदान अधिक बळकट करणे हेच या सेनेचे प्रमुख उद्दिष्ट आहे.

en.title: Allied Senas
en.lede: Senas aligned with Shiv Sena's vision and active in different fields — every voice of every constituency reaches the party family.

orgs.name: Shivsena National Employees Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena National Employees Sena is dedicated to safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of employees working in government, semi-government, public sector, and private sector organisations across the country. It advocates on matters related to service conditions, salaries, promotions, pensions, workplace rights, and various administrative issues, while actively engaging with the appropriate authorities to seek effective resolutions. Committed to ensuring justice, dignity, and a secure working environment for employees, the organisation serves as a strong and organised voice for the workforce through collective representation and public service.

orgs.name: Shivsena Sahakar Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Sahakar Sena is committed to strengthening Maharashtra’s cooperative movement and safeguarding the interests of cooperative institutions. It actively represents issues concerning cooperative sugar factories, milk unions, credit societies, agricultural cooperatives, housing societies, and other cooperative organisations before the relevant authorities. The organisation works to promote transparency, efficiency, and people-centric governance within the cooperative sector while protecting the interests of farmers, members, and the general public. Its objective is to reinforce Maharashtra’s cooperative tradition by balancing development with public welfare.

orgs.name: Shiv Kamgar Sena
orgs.body: Shiv Kamgar Sena is a prominent labour organisation dedicated to protecting the rights and welfare of workers in both the organised and unorganised sectors. It represents employees engaged in industries, factories, service establishments, and various workplaces by advocating for fair wages, equitable service conditions, workplace safety, social security, and employment-related issues. The organisation works consistently with the relevant authorities to ensure justice, dignity, and secure working conditions for workers while promoting harmony and stability in the industrial sector.

orgs.name: Shivsena Shivsamarthya Organisation
orgs.body: The Shivsena Shivsamarthya Organisation is dedicated to empowering underprivileged, vulnerable, and economically disadvantaged sections of society by promoting their social, educational, and economic development. It raises awareness about key social issues, facilitates access to government welfare schemes, and undertakes initiatives aimed at advancing social justice and community empowerment. Driven by the principles of organisation, self-respect, and self-confidence, the organisation strives to enable every individual to realise their full potential and participate meaningfully in society.

orgs.name: Shivsena Jai Maharashtra Mathadi and General Workers Sena
orgs.body: The Shivsena Jai Maharashtra Mathadi and General Workers Sena is dedicated to protecting the rights of Mathadi workers, loaders, transport workers, warehouse personnel, and labourers employed in various segments of the unorganised sector. It actively pursues issues related to employment security, fair wages, labour welfare schemes, social protection, and the enforcement of workers’ legal rights. By providing an organised platform for unorganised workers and effectively representing their concerns before government and administrative authorities, the organisation seeks to promote dignity, economic stability, and workplace security for the labour force.

orgs.name: Shiv Hawkers Sena
orgs.body: The Shiv Hawkers Sena is committed to protecting the rights and livelihoods of street vendors, handcart operators, small traders, and others who depend on informal retail activities for their income. The organisation advocates on matters relating to hawker policies, licensing, designated vending spaces, local administrative issues, and the right to livelihood. Recognising the important contribution of street vendors to the urban economy, it works to ensure that they can conduct their businesses with dignity and without unjust treatment while safeguarding their economic security and legal rights.

orgs.name: Shivsena Maharashtra Muslim Mehter Sanitation Workers Cell
orgs.body: The Shivsena Maharashtra Muslim Mehter Sanitation Workers Cell is dedicated to protecting the rights and improving the quality of life of sanitation workers belonging to the Muslim Mehter community. The organisation advocates for fair wages, job security, healthcare benefits, social protection, and access to government welfare schemes for workers engaged in sanitation services. By giving organised representation to a community that has historically faced significant challenges, the Cell works to secure justice, dignity, and meaningful social empowerment for sanitation workers.

orgs.name: Shiv Transport Sena
orgs.body: The Shiv Transport Sena represents the interests of individuals and businesses associated with the freight and passenger transport sectors across Maharashtra. It actively addresses issues affecting truck operators, tempo owners, taxi drivers, auto-rickshaw operators, bus operators, transport workers, and other stakeholders by engaging with the government on matters relating to licensing, taxation, regulation, and business operations. Recognising transportation as a vital pillar of the state’s economy, the organisation is committed to protecting the interests of the sector, securing fair treatment for its members, and promoting a safe, efficient, and well-organised transportation system.

orgs.name: Swabhimani Leather Industry Workers Association
orgs.body: The Swabhimani Leather Industry Workers Association is dedicated to protecting the rights and interests of workers, artisans, and individuals engaged in the traditional leather industry. The association advocates for issues related to employment, working conditions, social security, skill development, and other challenges faced by the sector. It also works to preserve traditional craftsmanship while connecting workers with modern technologies and emerging opportunities. Its primary objective is to ensure dignity, justice, and avenues for progress for those employed in the leather industry.

orgs.name: Hindustan Film Workers Union
orgs.body: The Hindustan Film Workers Union represents technicians, support staff, and workers whose tireless efforts drive the film industry behind the scenes. The union addresses issues related to employment, remuneration, working conditions, and professional safety for individuals involved in film production. It strives to safeguard workers’ interests, ensure recognition for their contributions, create opportunities for skill development, and provide an effective platform to address their concerns in the evolving entertainment industry. The union is widely regarded as a trusted voice for film industry workers.

orgs.name: Shiv Bhim Sena Foundation
orgs.body: Inspired by the ideals and contributions of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Bharat Ratna Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar, the Shiv Bhim Sena Foundation works towards social awareness, education, and community development. Its key objectives include empowering marginalized and underprivileged sections of society, fostering self-respect and social responsibility among youth, and promoting social harmony and awareness of constitutional values. Through various social, educational, and public welfare initiatives, the Foundation encourages dialogue and active participation across communities. Its work is guided by the principles of public service, dignity, and inclusive progress.

orgs.name: Republican Charmakar Federation, Maharashtra State
orgs.body: The Republican Charmakar Federation, Maharashtra State serves as a collective platform dedicated to the social, educational, and economic advancement of the Charmakar community. The Federation addresses challenges associated with traditional occupations while promoting educational opportunities, employment, skill development, and access to government welfare schemes. It also undertakes initiatives to strengthen community organisation, expand opportunities for youth, and encourage greater social participation. The Federation remains committed to advancing the confidence, dignity, and overall development of the Charmakar community.

orgs.name: Bharatiya Lokshakti Party
orgs.body: The Bharatiya Lokshakti Party is committed to raising issues of public interest and ensuring that ordinary citizens receive justice through democratic means. The party works to represent the aspirations of diverse communities and to bring local concerns and development-related matters before the government and administrative authorities. Through public awareness campaigns, community engagement, and organisational initiatives, it encourages greater civic participation and democratic involvement. Upholding democratic values and prioritising public welfare remain the party’s guiding principles.

orgs.name: All India Cable Sena
orgs.body: The All India Cable Sena provides a unified platform for entrepreneurs, distributors, and workers associated with the cable television, broadband, and broadcasting sectors. In an era of rapid technological advancement, the organisation offers guidance and actively addresses commercial, technical, and administrative challenges affecting the industry. It works to protect the interests of local cable operators, ensure quality services for consumers, and support employment opportunities within the sector. The organisation serves as a strong representative voice for stakeholders in the broadcasting and communications industry.

orgs.name: Maharashtra State Women Workers Association
orgs.body: The Maharashtra State Women Workers Association is dedicated to representing and addressing the concerns of women employed across various sectors. It works on issues relating to wages, workplace safety, maternity rights, social security, healthcare, and the overall welfare of women workers. The association actively engages with relevant authorities to ensure that women in both organised and unorganised sectors receive fair opportunities, dignity, and safe working environments.

orgs.name: National Workers Union
orgs.body: The National Workers Union provides an organised platform for workers employed across industrial, service, and unorganised sectors. It actively addresses issues related to job security, wages, service conditions, social protection, and worker welfare in response to changing economic and industrial conditions. The Union also promotes constructive dialogue between workers and management to maintain industrial harmony while safeguarding employees’ interests. It remains committed to ensuring the dignity, security, and advancement of the working class.

orgs.name: Maharashtra Construction Industry Sena
orgs.body: The Maharashtra Construction Industry Sena represents entrepreneurs, contractors, engineers, and other stakeholders associated with the construction and infrastructure sectors across the state. The organisation addresses policy matters, regulatory issues, administrative approvals, labour management, and challenges affecting industry growth. It works to create a supportive environment for the construction sector, facilitate timely execution of development projects, and effectively present industry concerns before the government. Its primary objective is to strengthen the contribution of the construction industry toward building a modern and development-oriented Maharashtra.

sections.title: शिवसेनेचे ध्येय
sections.body: मराठी माणसाचा स्वाभिमान, हिंदुत्वाचा जाज्वल्य अभिमान आणि महाराष्ट्राच्या अस्मितेचे रक्षण हेच शिवसेनेचे प्रमुख ध्येय आहे. शिवसेनाप्रमुख हिंदूहृदयसम्राट बाळासाहेब ठाकरे यांनी स्थापन केलेली शिवसेना ही केवळ राजकीय संघटना नसून सर्वसामान्य जनतेच्या हक्कासाठी लढणारी एक व्यापक चळवळ आहे. शेतकरी, कामगार, कष्टकरी, मध्यमवर्गीय, युवक, महिला, ज्येष्ठ नागरिक, उद्योजक, विद्यार्थी तसेच समाजातील प्रत्येक घटकाला न्याय, सन्मान आणि विकासाच्या मुख्य प्रवाहात आणणे, हे शिवसेनेचे कर्तव्य मानले जाते. समाजातील शेवटच्या घटकापर्यंत विकास पोहोचवणे, युवकांना रोजगाराच्या संधी उपलब्ध करून देणे, महिलांचे सक्षमीकरण करणे आणि राष्ट्रहित सर्वोच्च मानून कार्य करणे, या विचारांवर शिवसेना आजही ठामपणे उभी आहे.

sections.title: शिवसेनेचे धोरण
sections.body: “८० टक्के समाजकारण आणि २० टक्के राजकारण” हे शिवसेनेचे मूलभूत धोरण आहे.  शिवसेनाप्रमुख हिंदूहृदयसम्राट बाळासाहेब ठाकरे यांनी दिलेला हिंदुत्वाचा मार्ग आत्मसात करत सामान्य जनतेच्या प्रश्नांसाठी रस्त्यावर उतरून संघर्ष करणे, हिंदुत्व आणि राष्ट्रवादाची भूमिका ठामपणे मांडणे, मराठी माणसाच्या हक्कांसाठी लढणे आणि जनकल्याणाला प्राधान्य देणे हे शिवसेनेचे धोरण आहे. विकास, जनसेवा, संघटनशक्ती आणि लोकाभिमुख प्रशासन यांच्या माध्यमातून महाराष्ट्राला अधिक सक्षम आणि समृद्ध बनवण्याचा शिवसेनेचा संकल्प आहे.

sections.title: Our Vision
sections.body: Protecting the self-respect of the Marathi people, the fierce pride of Hindutva, and the dignity of Maharashtra — that is Shiv Sena's foremost goal. Founded by Hindu-Hridaysamrat Shiv Sena chief Balasaheb Thackeray, Shiv Sena is not merely a political organization but a broad movement that fights for the rights of the common people — farmers, workers, the labouring class, the middle class, youth, women, senior citizens, entrepreneurs, students, and every section of society — to bring them justice, dignity, and into the mainstream of development.

sections.title: Our Policy
sections.body: “80% social work and 20% politics” is Shiv Sena's foundational policy. Adopting the path of Hindutva given by Hindu-Hridaysamrat Shiv Sena chief Balasaheb Thackeray, taking to the streets for the common people's concerns, firmly upholding Hindutva and nationalism, fighting for the rights of the Marathi people, and prioritising public welfare — this is Shiv Sena's policy. Through development, public service, organisational strength, and people-oriented administration, Shiv Sena is resolved to build a stronger, more prosperous Maharashtra.
